newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy banks see limited inflation upturn in H2 97.
newsitem.headline: Italy banks see limited inflation upturn in H2 97.

text.p: Italian bankers expect to see only a limited upturn in consumer price inflation in the second half of this year while economic recovery will continue to be slow.
The forecast was made in the latest monthly report of the Italian Banking Association (ABI).

"The significant deceleration (in CPI to a yearly 1.7 percent in April from 2.2 percent in March)...indicates that the expected rise in the inflationary trend in the second part of the year may be rather limited," the report said.
As for the economy, ABI saw "a slow exit from the phase of stagnation which has characterised the most recent period."

"A picture of relative uncertainty remains, with companies appearing to interpret signals of recovery with a certain caution," ABI said, while households "seem to view the short-term economic situation with less optimism."
